films.title: L'Odissea
films.description: Rossi's Odyssey keeps Odysseus' comrades on Circe's isle — Polites among the scouts who enter the witch's hall before the crew is penned as swine.

films.title: The Odyssey
films.description: Konchalovsky's miniseries stages the Circe landing where Homer's Polites, dearest and most thoughtful of the companions, leads the men to the goddess's door.

popCulture.title: Odyssey
popCulture.creator: Homer
popCulture.description: Book 10: Polites, 'dearest to me of my companions and most trusty,' calls the crew to Circe's house — the scout whose voice opens the enchantment.

popCulture.title: Polites
popCulture.description: Companion of Odysseus — carefully distinct from Polites son of Priam, the Trojan prince Neoptolemus slays.

popCulture.title: Circe
popCulture.description: The goddess whose hall Polites enters — the witch who drugs the crew and is later mastered by Odysseus' moly.
